strengths: The central thesis is clear: the bottleneck moved from writing to absorption.
The opening PR-review scene grounds the article in lived engineering work.
The three ability sections are useful and technically legible.
The PR template is a strong practical takeaway.
residual_patterns: Heading bold markers make the Markdown look generated.
Evidence sections sometimes read like a research digest.
The PR criteria section uses a textbook enumeration rhythm.
Several English research terms can be softened or translated.
NBSP characters remain near citation sentences.
recommendation: Use v5.5-pro as the base, then run a local polish pass focused on formatting, evidence density, and PR-section rhythm.
